data.name: Fairies Circus
data.detailed_description:
About this game

Immerse yourself in horror in first person: you play as Joe and face the horror. Your wife has disappeared, the house is not safe anymore and something is stalking you. Explore, solve puzzles and escape before it's too late. You are not alone... and time is running out.

Synopsis

Joe Smith and his wife, Emily, have moved to a new house in the suburbs. For Joe, this move represents a new beginning, a chance to leave behind the haunting memories of his childhood. However, that sense of security is shattered the afternoon he awakens from a nap to discover that Emily is gone.

On the table, an old, crumpled circus brochure catches his eye. His hands tremble as he touches it. Faires' Circus... a name that echoes in her mind like a cursed echo. That circus was the scene of his worst nightmares as a child.

He knows he shouldn't go, but something inside him urges him to investigate. When he arrives, he finds the circus abandoned and closed. The breeze brings the distant sound of a child's laughter, but the place is deserted. Bewildered, he returns home... only to discover that the light is gone and he is not alone.

The house, which until a few hours ago seemed a haven of peace, now feels oppressive. Joe feels he is being watched. Fleeting shadows glide through the hallways. Whispers echo in the gloom. Every step he takes seems to resound with a presence that moves with him.

Soon he finds signs that the house was never empty. Doors that close on their own, objects that appear in places where he never left them.

Discover the dark secrets of Faires' Circus... before it's too late.

Features

Psychological horror in first person: Live the fear through Joe's eyes.

A house: Places full of secrets, riddles ...

Puzzles and survival: Find clues, solve puzzles and escape before it's too late.

Immersive story: Based on trauma, madness and fear of the unknown.

Immersive sound: Every whisper, every creak... nothing is random.

Immersive Graphics: AAA-quality graphics that give players a detailed and terrifying world to explore.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-8100 o AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 (6 GB), AMD Radeon RX 5600XT o Intel Arc A750 (8 GB)
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or later
  • Processor: i5-3570K 3.4 GHz 4 Core
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1650 series or similar
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
